def ClassicalTrigBernstein : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ), 1 ≤ d → ∀ (T : ℝ → ℂ), T ∈ trigPolynomialSpace d →
    ∀ (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → (∀ t : ℝ, ‖T t‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, ‖deriv T t‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) * M

source.title: On Bernstein’s inequality for polynomials
source.publication: Classical Bernstein theorem; cited survey statement

inputs.meaning: For every d>=1 and every genuine complex trigonometric polynomial with frequencies of absolute value at most d, any nonnegative global magnitude upper bound M bounds the magnitude of the derivative at every real point by d*M.
inputs.source_alignment: Native polynomial to cosine-lift membership, coordinate paths, all cell estimates and tensor norming are proved internally. Only the classical univariate supremum Bernstein inequality is parameterized.

def BernoulliLowerHalfInput {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (Y : Fin M → Ω → Bool), (∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) → iIndepFun Y P →
    ∀ p : ℝ, (∀ i, P.real {ω | Y i ω = true} = p) →
      P.real {ω | boolCount (fun i => Y i ω) Finset.univ < (M : ℝ) * p / 2} ≤
        Real.exp (-(M : ℝ) * p / 8)

source.authors: D. P. Dubhashi and A. Panconesi
source.title: Concentration of Measure for the Analysis of Randomized Algorithms
source.reference: Theorem 1.1, equation (1.7), lower tail, epsilon=1/2, pages 6–7

internally_discharged_standard_contracts.meaning: Independent measurable Bool variables of a common success probability p satisfy Pr[count < M*p/2] <= exp(-M*p/8). The calling probability space has IsProbabilityMeasure P; equality of the probabilities to p implies its valid probability range.
internally_discharged_standard_contracts.source_alignment: This is only the fixed single-cell occupancy concentration inequality. Random membership patterns, independence of the two entire blocks, random-subset transfer, all grid constants, and the m^n finite union are proved internally.
internally_discharged_standard_contracts.lean_availability: Both interfaces are now proved in Paper34/StandardConcentration.lean from pinned mathlib; all final source main/appendix wrappers automatically instantiate them.

internally_discharged_standard_contracts.lean_definition:
def BernoulliSubsetHoeffdingInput {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (Y : Fin M → Ω → Bool), (∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) → iIndepFun Y P →
    ∀ rho a : ℝ, 0 ≤ rho → rho < a →
      (∀ i, P.real {ω | Y i ω = true} ≤ rho) →
      ∀ S : Finset (Fin M),
        P.real {ω | a * (S.card : ℝ) < boolCount (fun i => Y i ω) S} ≤
          Real.exp (-2 * (a - rho) ^ 2 * (S.card : ℝ))

source.authors: D. P. Dubhashi and A. Panconesi
source.title: Concentration of Measure for the Analysis of Randomized Algorithms
source.reference: Theorem 1.1, equation (1.6), pages 6–7; deterministic subset and t=(a-rho)*card

internally_discharged_standard_contracts.meaning: Every fixed finite subset of mutually independent measurable Bool variables with individually bounded success probabilities <=rho, where 0<=rho<a, satisfies Pr[a*card(S)<count(S)]<=exp(-2*(a-rho)^2*card(S)). Nonidentical rates and the empty subset are included.
internally_discharged_standard_contracts.source_alignment: The formal input does not assert concentration after random selection. The proof of random_subset_hoeffding_transfer establishes that own-paper step from independence of the entire location and outlier vectors.
